title: Normal strongly continuous spatial Markov semigroups on bounded operators of separable Hilbert spaces admit weak Hudson-Parthasarathy dilations
author: Michael Skeide
work: Spatial Markov Semigroups Admit Hudson-Parthasarathy Dilations
source_version: Official SIGMA 18 (2022) article 071, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2022.071; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-09-30, exact bytes pinned by SHA256
difficulty_reason: The proof constructs a noise from the spatial product system and amplifies it without changing that system. It then chooses a unitary identification carrying the original dilation isometry to the noise isometry, transports the cocycle conjugacy, and checks the conditional-expectation identity using the increasing corner projection. These compatibility steps convert product-system classification into an actual weak dilation and establish the converse through spatiality of weak dilations.

source_check.note: Full author Theorem2.9 proof is read and bundled. The hypotheses are point-strong continuity, normal unital CP maps on B(G), G separable, and spatiality by domination of an elementary CP semigroup as in Definition2.8. The conclusion selected is the equivalence with a weak HP dilation as in Definition2.5; weakness is essential, and the source states the converse for general HP dilations is unknown. Bhat weak dilation/product-system spatiality and Arveson cocycle classification/construction are genuinely prior background explicitly cited. The author supplies the noise amplification, compatible isometry identification, cocycle transport and corner/conditional-expectation calculation. Footnote10 provides the supporting inductive-limit explanation of infinite-dimensional complements in the nonendomorphic case. Reversible extension is contextual and not a separately counted consequence. Source approval supplied only by exact frozen root input; no new source/difficulty decision or mathematical referee.
